answer: Operator Liability Escrow: each operator posts a per-identity escrow funded from a shared operator account, not the wallet. On a verified sybil cluster, a beacon flags the operator, and all their escrows are slashed together. Each identity also signs a periodic challenge the operator must co-sign, or it burns like an ember. Creating N identities therefore costs the operator N escrows plus one willow attestation per challenge cycle, payable whether or not the cluster is caught.
